editorial_notes: Fish and plant counts are snapshots from a private source repository and are published here as a limited summary with user approval.
A record is not a complete, reviewed species profile.
Project previews and prototype pages are not app-store production releases.
Proposed tissue-culture studio workflow is demonstrative, not a past client engagement.
FloraTrack's botanical species and cultivar provenance counts come from its July 2026 database inventory; the live local SQLite database was not independently re-queried for this web release.
All figures are rounded down for display; individual source corpora have varying maturity.
